description: cmdorganization is an emerging cyber threat actor specializing in corporate system security vulnerabilities and ransomware attacks. With a primary motivation of financial gain, cmdorganization has targeted multiple industries globally since its first sighting in early 2026. This group leverages sophisticated tactics to penetrate organizational systems and encrypt data for ransom, posing significant risks to businesses and their operational continuity.
